_comment: Single source of truth for provider capability tiers. The console reads this at spawn time and resolves (provider, tier) -> model id; nothing is compiled into the binary. Edit this file (or ~/.port-daddy/model-tiers.json, which overrides it) and the change takes effect on the next spawn — no rebuild. Every model id MUST exist in the daemon's cost-rate registry (lib/cost-tracker MODEL_RATES) or the launch fails closed with a 'no cost rate entry' message; when that happens, fix the id here. The 'low' tier of each provider mirrors the daemon's DEFAULT_OPERATOR_*_MODEL, which is guaranteed priced.

deepseek._comment: DeepSeek OpenAI-compatible API. deepseek-chat = V3 (general+coder), deepseek-reasoner = R1 (reasoning). 'low' mirrors DEFAULT_DEEPSEEK_MODEL (deepseek-chat) and is priced in cost-tracker MODEL_RATES.

xai._comment: xAI (Grok) OpenAI-compatible API. grok-2-latest = general high/mid, grok-code-fast-1 = fast coder/low. 'low' mirrors DEFAULT_XAI_MODEL and is priced in cost-tracker MODEL_RATES.

lmstudio._comment: LM Studio serves whatever model is loaded in the app; the concrete id is resolved at runtime (GET /v1/models reports it). 'local-model' is the conventional placeholder and is priced by the daemon's lmstudio catch-all electricity-proxy rate, so every tier launches. Load 'Qwen 3 Next Coder' as the prime in LM Studio.
